# cpanel_email_routing (Data Source)

Looks up the cPanel email routing mode for an account domain. This describes cPanel's local delivery configuration and does not manage MX DNS records.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cpanel_email_routing" "mail" {
  domain = "mail.example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) The existing account domain to look up.

### Read-Only

- `detected_mode` (String) The effective routing mode detected from the highest-priority mail exchanger.
- `mode` (String) The configured cPanel email routing mode: `auto`, `local`, `backup`, or `remote`.
- `primary_exchanger` (String) The highest-priority mail exchanger reported by cPanel.
